title: Last Train Home
description: A tired cat rides the last train home across an endless sea. Remember the coach you are shown: if nothing has changed, walk on through the door ahead. If a passenger or the coach itself has changed, turn back through the door behind. Four changed coaches and you are home — two where a passenger has turned, two where the coach itself is wrong, and which four is re-shuffled every ride.
